guidance.bestFor: The minimal row: one switch, off on load, left of its Airplane Mode label in a horizontal Field

whenNotToUse.when: Several related options stacked under one shared heading

guidance.bestFor: A title over a supporting sentence with the control at the right, the whole row one clickable label

whenNotToUse.when: Several described options laid out as tiles in 2 columns
An option that erases data and needs a red title and an irreversible warning

guidance.bestFor: Locked rows in both states, one off and one on, that stay readable but cannot be flipped
The sm and default sizes stacked for comparison, to match the control to dense or regular rows
agentNotes: `size` on `Switch` accepts only sm and default; no larger size ships with the component

guidance.bestFor: A headed stack of email, SMS and push channels, each control left of its label and 2 on at load

whenNotToUse.when: The same channels boxed in a card with a divider between rows

name: c-switch-6
title: Switch list in card with separators
label: Card Separators
description: Switch list in card with separators

guidance.bestFor: A card holding 3 channel rows split by separators, each name at the left and its toggle at the right edge

whenNotToUse.when: Rows that need a small leading icon before each name
A panel that needs a title bar above its rows

name: c-switch-7
title: Switch list in card with icons
label: Card With Icons
description: Switch list in card with icons

guidance.bestFor: Rows that lead with a dimmed bell, mail or phone icon before each channel name, in a divided card

whenNotToUse.when: Plain text rows with no leading icon

guidance.bestFor: Privacy rows in a Frame panel below a header titled Privacy Settings, 2 of the 3 on at load

whenNotToUse.when: Rows in a plain card with no title above them

guidance.bestFor: A sign in security option whose label is followed by a help icon that explains it in a tooltip
agentNotes: The radix twin wraps `Tooltip` in `TooltipProvider`, which a Radix tooltip throws without; drop it only when your app root mounts one
The help `TooltipTrigger` holds only an `aria-hidden` icon, so the button has no accessible name; label it for screen readers

whenNotToUse.when: Help text that stays on screen below the label at all times

guidance.bestFor: Preview feature rows tagged with New and Beta pills after the label, such as an AI copilot
Custom on colors set per control through a data-checked class, here blue, green and yellow

whenNotToUse.when: A red on state that warns about losing data

guidance.bestFor: A data wiping option with red title text, an irreversible warning below it and a red track when on
agentNotes: The warning is a static `FieldDescription`; nothing asks the user to confirm when the `Switch` turns on

whenNotToUse.when: A one time delete that must be confirmed before it runs

guidance.bestFor: Editor preferences mapped from an array into dense rows, each with a short hint and a small toggle
agentNotes: Replace `settings` with your preferences; each entry's `checked` only seeds `defaultChecked` and is never written back

whenNotToUse.when: Records spread over several columns under a header row

name: c-switch-14
title: Switch with descriptions in card grid
label: Card Grid
description: Switch with descriptions in card grid

guidance.bestFor: A 2 column grid of service tiles, each with a bordered icon box, a brief description and a small toggle
agentNotes: Replace `features` with your services; the `checked` flag on each entry is only the starting state
`FieldGroup` keeps `grid-cols-2` at every width, so the 4 tiles stay 2 across on a phone; add a 1 column base for narrow screens

whenNotToUse.when: Tiles where exactly 1 option may be on at a time
